LTV on Hnm 10k:
PREDICT SUM(transactions.price, 0, 90, days)
FOR EACH customers.customer_id
WHERE TEMPORAL ENTITY FILTER IS SUM(transactions.price, -60, 0, days) > 0
ASSUMING COUNT(transactions.*, 0, 90, days) > 0
LTV on Hnm 10k - AVG:
PREDICT AVG(transactions.price, 0, 90, days)
FOR EACH customers.customer_id
WHERE TEMPORAL ENTITY FILTER IS SUM(transactions.price, -60, 0, days) > 0
ASSUMING COUNT(transactions.*, 0, 90, days) > 0
LTV on Hnm 10k - LAST:
PREDICT LAST(transactions.price, 0, 90, days)
FOR EACH customers.customer_id
WHERE TEMPORAL ENTITY FILTER IS SUM(transactions.price, -60, 0, days) > 0
ASSUMING COUNT(transactions.*, 0, 90, days) > 0
Churn on Hnm 10k:
PREDICT COUNT(transactions.*, 0, 90, days) > 0
FOR EACH customers.customer_id
WHERE TEMPORAL ENTITY FILTER IS SUM(transactions.price, -60, 0, days) > 0.05
LTV with entity filters:
PREDICT SUM(transactions.price, 0, 90, days)
FOR EACH customers.customer_id
WHERE TEMPORAL ENTITY FILTER IS LAST(transactions.sales_channel_id, -60, 0, days) = 1
ENTITY FILTER IS (customers.fashion_news_frequency = "NONE") AND (customers.age > 30)
